sources.entry: SilverStripe - Easy to use CMS with powerful MVC framework underlying. (Demo, Source Code) BSD-3-Clause PHP

summary.name: SilverStripe
summary.one_liner: Silverstripe CMS is an open-source content management system built on the Silverstripe Framework, a PHP MVC framework for building and customising websites.
use_cases: Building and managing a company or agency website
Launching marketing campaign pages without full development cycles
Giving editors access to only specific areas of a site
Developing customised PHP web applications on an MVC framework
Managing content on large multi-page sites
Finding freelance developers or agencies to build a CMS site
summary.what_it_does: Silverstripe CMS is a content management system for editors, built on the Silverstripe Framework, a PHP MVC framework for developers. The page says it can be extended and customised to fit specific business needs rather than forcing an out-of-the-box solution. It offers a frontend-oriented templating engine and permission controls that let administrators give editors access to only certain site areas. The page lists support for publishing single pages or many pages on large sites. The project is open source with community contributions and commercial support from Silverstripe. The page also links to a developer directory, learning resources, and reports 50,000+ live sites, 2,500+ modules, and 400+ freelance developers and agencies.
notable: Built on a PHP MVC framework that can be used for custom development
Open source (BSD-3-Clause per listing) with commercial support available
Large ecosystem: 2,500+ modules and 4,000+ showcased sites
caveats: Commercial support and enterprise-level security are provided by Silverstripe, the company; the page does not detail pricing for these
Page is largely marketing; specific features and requirements are not detailed
